label: Aquinas's immateriality/cognition ordering supports an open universal intellect bridge
note: ST I q.14 a.1 gives the graded immateriality/cognition connection and specifically argues from God's highest immateriality to knowledge. It does not equate the two formal negations ¬ComposedOfMatterAndForm x and ∀ y, ¬ComponentOf x y with highest immateriality for every x, nor give an unconditional rule to HasIntellect x. Both steps are analyst commitments (see STMT-ALTOGETHER-IMMATERIAL-IS-MAXIMALLY-IMMATERIAL and STMT-INTELLECT-FOLLOWS-GRADE-OF-IMMATERIALITY). The strong conditional's Lean status is unchanged.
